title: Special Rate — a row with no saved record shows a Modified On time
requirementSource: NM-4022 — TestRail C107704: Modified On is "-" too, not a time
stepsToReproduce: Open Tax → Special Rate for office 1606 (/navigator/locations/1606/taxes/special-rate) on e2e.
Read the Audio Conferencing row (no saved record).
actualBehavior: Modified By is "-" but Modified On shows the current time (e.g. 11/09/2026 06:42:27 AM).

verificationLog.finding: Failed in the full run and the isolated rerun; the time shown changes with each search.
